root_cause.text: The `ucsi_notify_common()` function failed to validate that the connector number extracted from the CCI register was within the valid range of the allocated connector array before using

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The vulnerability exists because `ucsi_notify_common()` uses a connector number extracted from the hardware CCI register as an array index without verifying it is within the bounds of the allocated connector array (`ucsi->cap.num_connectors`).
agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch adds a conditional check `if (UCSI_CCI_CONNECTOR(cci) <= ucsi->cap.num_connectors)` in `ucsi_notify_common()` to reject out-of-range values reported by the device before they reach `ucsi_connector_change()`.

vuln_statements.explanation: Based on the root cause, the ucis_notify_common() function accesses the connector array using cci.connector value extracted from the CCI register without validating it is within the valid range of the allocated connector array. This unvalidated array access allows out-of-bounds memory access when the connector number exceeds the array bounds.
